title: Curvature-Aware Clipping: Mitigating Bias in DPSGD via Approximate Second-Order Information
abstract: arXiv:2610.32175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DPSGD) has become the de facto standard for training deep neural networks with rigorous privacy guarantees. However, the utility of DPSGD is constrained by gradient clipping bias and DP noise. While existing work has tried to address these issues, the geometric misalignment caused by clipping bias remains a critical challenge. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework, Curvature-Aware Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (CA-DPSGD), which leverages approximate second-order information to construct an optimal, curvature-aware clipping space. CA-DPSGD integrates a rectified estimator for the curvature matrix and is coupled with an anisotropic noise mechanism to ensure privacy guarantees. Extensive empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art clipping methods.

translated_title: 曲率感知裁剪：利用近似二阶信息缓解DPSGD中的偏差
translated_abstract: 差分隐私随机梯度下降（DPSGD）已成为在严格隐私保证下训练深度神经网络的事实标准。然而，DPSGD的性能受到梯度裁剪偏差和差分隐私噪声的制约。尽管已有研究尝试解决这些问题，但由裁剪偏差引起的几何错位仍然是一个关键挑战。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——曲率感知差分隐私随机梯度下降（CA-DPSGD），该框架利用近似二阶信息构建一个最优的、曲率感知的裁剪空间。CA-DPSGD集成了一个经过校正的曲率矩阵估计器，并结合各向异性噪声机制以确保隐私保证。大量的实证实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的裁剪方法。
tldr: 提出CA-DPSGD框架，利用近似二阶信息构建曲率感知的最优裁剪空间，并结合各向异性噪声机制，有效缓解DPSGD中的梯度裁剪偏差问题，性能超越现有最先进的裁剪方法。
en_tdlr: CA-DPSGD leverages approximate second-order information to construct an optimal curvature-aware clipping space coupled with an anisotropic noise mechanism, mitigating gradient clipping bias in DPSGD and outperforming state-of-the-art clipping methods.
